title: Cosmic Ocean Vortex
description: A vibrant surreal seascape at sunset featuring a large luminous spiral vortex of rainbow colors emerging from turbulent ocean waves. Ethereal translucent female spirits with flowing white hair float around the vortex, surrounded by glowing lotus flowers, fish, crescent moons, and astrological symbols against a dramatic sky.
